identification: Copper and brass box oil lantern: clear bevelled glass on three sides, a round hinged door on the fourth side with a polished reflector on its inner face, a small wick burner inside with an external brass wick-winder knob, pierced mesh vent bands top and bottom, flat overhanging top with three brass knobs, small feet. No lens or signalling shutter, and no maker's plate, broad-arrow or railway stamp visible in the five photos.
viewing_check: The front bevelled panel has several cracks and the adjoining side panel is cracked too (photos 4 and 5); check the third panel. Look under the base, under the top plate and on the burner for a maker's name, broad arrow or railway initials (none visible in the photos), check the reflector door hinge and catch, and measure it. Nothing of this box form (bevelled side glass, reflector door, mesh vents) turned up as a sale outside the two local rooms in the last 24 months, so there is still no outside sold price to set a max.

viewing_check: Read the set number on the Hornby box ends or lid (R.572 or R.773 if it is the Spirit of Progress set). identification: Part Sidchrome 3/4 in drive socket set in a red steel case: large ratchet, sliding T-bar, long and short extensions, about 15 sockets (6 and 12 point, one black impact deep socket) and what looks like a reducer or adaptor; a loose bolt; case rusty with pine-needle debris

entries.note: 'Sidchrome 3/4" Drive Ratchet Wrench'. Long-handled ratchet on its own. Buy It Now/Best Offer, no accepted offer shown. Price shown includes eBay's buyer protection fee.
'Vintage Sidchrome 3/4 " Ratchet'. Shorter ratchet with knurled handle, on its own.
'Sidchrome vintage 3/4 drive large sockets'. Two large sockets. 4 bids. Includes a A$1.36 buyer protection fee.
'1980's Vintage Sidchrome 3/4 Drive Empty Socket Case'. Empty case only. 6 bids. From the sold card; item page would not load.
'Vintage Sidchrome L Handle Socket Wrench 3/4" Square Head Heavy Duty T...'. Handle only. From the sold card, not opened.

'Vintage Sidchrome 3/4 Drive - 1 -1/4 BS Socket - 1791-0 -Made in Australia'. One socket, from the sold card. Other single vintage Sidchrome 3/4 in sockets: 30 mm A$25.80 (29 Sep, https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/336794572018), 24 mm A$20.80 (20 Sep, https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/336794575066), 7/8 Whitworth A$13.26 (15 Sep, https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/398230711115).

viewing_check: Count and size the sockets (AF, metric or Whitworth) and check the Sidchrome stamps; test the ratchet pawl; the case is rusty inside. Contents check on the already-found A$551.50 sale (298587133133): it was a full 31-piece Sidchrome 3/4 in combination socket set, Cat. No. 15105, label intact, case and tools clean, about 30 sockets plus ratchet, handles and extensions; no accepted offer shown, so A$551.50 was paid. It is not a fair comparison for this part set. No other Sidchrome 3/4 in sets sold on eBay AU in the last 90 days.

identification: Tray of about 12-13 old wooden planes: a long closed-tote try or jointer plane with a round metal strike button near the toe, a coffin smoother with double iron, a wedge-arm plough plane with brass depth-stop thumbscrew, iron skate and a bundle of spare irons tied on, and about 9 beech moulding and rebate planes (front one a skew rebate); no maker stamps visible in the photos

entries.note: 'Vintage Wooden Wood Planes x 11. tools, workshop, garage, shed, woodwo...'. Box of 11 wooden planes. From the sold card; the item page would not load, so the mix of plane types, makers and condition is not checked. No accepted offer shown.
'3 X Antique Wooden Moulding Planes Vintage Carpentry Woodworking Tool'. Three moulding planes. From the sold card, not opened.
'4x Antique Wooden Moulding Planes- Hand Tools for Carpentry Woodworking 1900s'. Four moulding planes. From the sold card, not opened.

'Vintage Mathiesons Wooden Hand Plane Metal Blade & Rear Handle Maker Stamped'. One maker-stamped wooden bench plane with a rear handle; length not given. From the sold card, not opened. Guide for the closed-tote plane if it turns out to be stamped.
'Vintage Wooden Timber Hand Plane Size 7'. One wooden bench plane, no maker in the title. From the sold card, not opened.
'Lot of 25 Vintage Wooden Molding Planes - REDUCED'. 25 moulding planes. From the sold card, not opened; USD figure not seen.
'7X Antique Wooden Moulding Planes Job Lot'. Seven moulding planes. From the sold card, not opened.
'Job Lot of 20 Vintage Wooden 'Boat' Planes in various condition'. 20 coffin-type smoothers, 12 bids. From the sold card, not opened. Shows how little coffin smoothers make in bulk in the UK.

viewing_check: Check the toe (front end grain) of each plane for maker stamps; none show in the photos. A named maker (Mathieson, Moseley, Varvill, Griffiths, Gabriel) lifts single planes to around A$50-90; unnamed ones sell for about A$5-15 each in groups. Count the planes (I make it about 12-13: jointer, coffin smoother, plough, about 9 moulding and rebate planes). Check for woodworm, split cheeks and missing irons or wedges; on the plough check the fence arms, wedges, skate and the bundle of spare irons tied to it. Correction to an already-found entry: the A$55 Greenslade plough (336783090709) was 'Best Offer accepted' with the price struck through, so the real price is hidden and was at or below A$55.

Count the small tins and look for any with intact lids and bright printing, since most look worn or rusty. I found no outside sale of an Old Oak tin; the comparables are other Pascall tins (A$10 to A$195) and mixed tobacco tin lots (Burns & Co selections A$30 to A$50 hammer in Mar 2026; eBay lots of 10 to 20 rusty tins A$54 to A$75).
